tools.name: company_check
tools.description: Check a UK home and interiors company by Companies House number or HouseJester page slug. Returns its available registration details and reviews.

tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: Which UK cities have home and interiors businesses on HouseJester? List available cities and business counts.

tools.name: city_detail
tools.description: Find verified home and interiors listings and top companies in a UK city, such as Leeds or Manchester.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: What kinds of home and interiors businesses are listed? Browse categories and listing counts.

tools.name: category_detail
tools.description: Find top businesses in a home and interiors category, such as fitted kitchens, bathrooms or flooring.

tools.name: listing_detail
tools.description: Get the details of a verified HouseJester business listing using its slug from search results.

tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Find verified UK home and interiors businesses by keyword and optional city, for example kitchen fitters in Leeds or roofing contractors in Manchester.
